Name: Kenneth's Summer Beach Party Gift
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Summer is here - let's party![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Every Summer 15, right in the middle of summer, you'll get a beach party gift in the mail. No festival that day, just pure summer vibes.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]I made this because Summer feels like it should have its own little celebration - beach day, tropical fruits, just chilling. So here's some pineapples, coconuts, mangoes, and warp totems to get to the beach fast.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What's inside:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]15x Pineapple, 10x Coconut, 10x Mango, 10x Banana, 10x Starfruit, 10x Pink Cake, 5x Warp Totem: Beach, 2x Chest, 3x Golden Mystery Box, Stardrop Tea + 12k gold.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Details:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Arrives via mail every Summer 15[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Yearly - comes back every Summer[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Balanced, lore-friendly, not cheaty[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- SDV 1.6+[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Super Lightweight - only Content Patcher, no extra dependencies, no performance impact[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- One version, just install and enjoy the beach![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Time for a beach party![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my yearly mail gift mods are on separate mod pages but they work perfectly together with no conflicts and no overwrites. You can install just one or all of them if you want to experience celebrations throughout the whole year - your choice! Full list:[/b][/size]
